g.text: Method 1 (GMR Baseline): Official temporal DETR baseline checkpoints evaluated with native bipartite matching.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Method 2 (GMR + SI-Bind [E6]): Full Structural Triad (Temporal Residual Stream + Slot-Private Innovation + Dominance-Aware Refresh).

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Method 3 (GMR + SI-Bind [E6] + GEQ [Ours]): Two-stage Global Event Query (GEQ) fine-tuning selected by Validation Orc-gap with 20 epochs patience.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Orc-Gap (%): Area between Oracle envelope and G-mIoU@1 threshold curve across tau in [0, 1] (Integral of Oracle_G1 minus G1-AUC). Lower is better.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Bold values highlight the optimal performance across all 3 configurations per backbone. FlashVTG E6 currently in queue.
